2019 Playoffs · Championship — Final
beowulf15 wins the title
def. bkunaal24 85.4–83.0

The week, in short

beowulf15 defeated bkunaal24 85.4–83.0 to win the 2019 Frequent Flyers championship.

Saquon Barkley (RB, PHI) led all players with 41.9 for misbah456; Kenyan Drake added 31.9 for Akilla; Tyler Boyd chipped in 29.3 for sgundlapalli.

sbhavsar "won" the toilet bowl, finishing the consolation bracket winless after falling 92.7–95.7 to sgundlapalli. The championship was decided by 2.4 points.

Week 32026 · regular season
158.8high · SaggyP

The week, in short

akm's unbeaten record survived by 1.96 points — the exact distance between their 117.54 and nshah3's 115.58, the week's closest final. Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 30.36 points went down with the losing side, the week's finest wasted effort. akm stays 3-0; nshah3 falls to 1-2, and has earned the right to be furious about it.

The week's high-water mark belonged to SaggyP: 158.82 points, a 31.59-point flattening of tmahadik93 built on Jahmyr Gibbs' 37.9 — the week's single best player line. Bijan Robinson answered with 34.3 for sbhavsar and lost anyway, which is simply what happens when you draw misbah456 (144.91–128.34). Brock Purdy's 31.28 quietly carried sgundlapalli's 147.63 past kuku24's 135.78 — a perfectly respectable score that still wasn't enough.

RSri12 administered the week's biggest blowout, 129.51–96.34 over Akilla — a 33.17-point margin that edged out the 30.16-point beating nayvadiusdawg put on praddy13 (121.0–90.84, the week's low), with Tyler Shough's 24.8 passing for a star turn on the winning side. In the standings, misbah456 are 3-0 with a league-best 477.34 points and 99.8% playoff odds; at the other end, praddy13 (0-3, 280.48 points) own the league's emptiest point total with 0.6% odds, kuku24 are 0-3 despite 381.48 points, and Akilla — back-to-back toilet-bowl champion — sits 10th at 1-2 with 8.3%. The threepeat is officially on the board.
